By way of present petition, petitioner seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus for directing the respondent respondents to release the entire balance compensation along with interest, as determined by respondent No.3 vide Awards Award dated 02.03.202 23 and 12.04.2023.
1 of 2 CM-18185-CWP-2025 2025 in/and CWP-22138-2024 [2].

After arguing for some time, lea learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since the Reference Petition (LAC/29/2024 titled 'DRA-cum-CALA CALA Hoshiarpur Vs. Neelam Rani and ors.') preferred under Section 3(H)(4) of the National Highway Act, 1956 (for the short 'the 1956 Act') has already been forwarded to the competent Court of Jurisdiction and the same is now pending consideration for 10.12.2025,
10.12.2025

sentences.text: , the learned Reference Court may be directed to expedite the proceedings in the said Reference Petition.
[3]. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and gone through the paper book.

[4]. Since ince the matter relates to the release of compensation and stands forwarded to the learned Reference Court under Section 3(H)(4) of the 1956 Act;
Act having considered that the acquisition acquisition in the case in hand commence commenced vide Notification dated 10.01.2023 under Sub-Section Section (1) of Section 3A the 1956 Act and the respondent-authorities respondent are in the process of taking over the possession of the acquired land in question, the learned Reference Cou Court rt is requested to expedite the proceedings in the aforementioned LAC/29/2024 to conclude the same preferably within one year from today.

[4]. It is made clear that in case, the CALA CALA/respondent No.3 has not deposited the amount of compensation with the learned Reference Court, the same be deposited immediately within one month from today today,, thereafter the petitioner shall be at liberty to approach the learned Reference Court for deposit of the same in some nationalized Bank in the form of FDR.
[5]. In view of above, the present writ petition is disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any shall also stand disposed of.
(HARKESH MANUJA)

December 04,
